ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels in the central regions and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the margins, tips, and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized white horizontal band bisecting both lobes. Thick black perimeter along the leading and trailing edges. High-density black mottling concentrated along the trailing edge of the right lobe and vertical linear streaks on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 55 degrees; base depth extends approximately 15% into the total vertical height of the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of up to 5-8 pixels. Distinctive deep indentation on the left lobe trailing edge approximately one-third of the distance from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward concavity on both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly frayed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered, low-density dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) observed primarily on the white background of the right lobe and inner lower sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear disruptions. Significant vertical rake-like marks on the left lobe at medial coordinates; diagonal scratches present on the right lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, ragged pixel formations at both distal tips suggesting structural tissue loss or heavy callousing; the left tip exhibits a cauliflower-like dark texture cluster.
